category_description: Pay, leave and government payments for people who work in Canada.
subcategory_description: Government payments for people who are out of work, raising children or on a low income.
label: Maximum CCB per year for each child under 6
context: The base benefit for the payment year. It is not reduced for families below the first income threshold.

label: Maximum CCB per year for each child aged 6 to 17
context: The base benefit for the payment year. It is not reduced for families below the first income threshold.

label: Adjusted family net income where the CCB reduction starts
context: Above this amount the benefit is reduced by a percentage of the extra income, and the percentage depends on the number of children.

label: Adjusted family net income where the second reduction starts
context: Above this amount the benefit is reduced by a fixed amount plus a percentage of the extra income.

label: Fixed reduction above the second threshold, one child
context: Added to a percentage of income above the second threshold.

label: Fixed reduction above the second threshold, two children
context: Added to a percentage of income above the second threshold.

label: Fixed reduction above the second threshold, three children
context: Added to a percentage of income above the second threshold.

label: Fixed reduction above the second threshold, four or more children
context: Added to a percentage of income above the second threshold.

label: Maximum child disability benefit per year
context: Paid for each child who is eligible for the disability tax credit, and reduced above the second threshold.

subject_intro: What the Canada child benefit is, who can get it, the maximum amounts for each child, and how family income reduces the payment.
